<!-- MO Agent is owner-maintained and does not accept unsolicited pull requests. -->

This pull request must correspond to an exact change requested by the maintainer.
Unsolicited implementations, feature proposals, and contributor onboarding are
outside this repository's participation model; use the product-defect issue form
for a sanitized, reproducible defect instead.

Describe the requested outcome, the verified source change, and the proportional
acceptance evidence. Do not include credentials, private profile data, local
paths, conversations, or maintainer-only artifacts.
